title: Dropdown Menu
api:
interface MenuProps {
  trigger: ReactElement
  items: Array<{
    label: string
    onClick?: () => void
    destructive?: boolean
    disabled?: boolean
    icon?: ReactNode
  }>
  className?: string
  disabled?: boolean
  /** Controlled open state, matching Popover and Modal. Omit it to let the menu manage itself. */
  open?: boolean
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void
  finalFocus?: ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof BaseMenu.Popup>['finalFocus']
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
}

function Menu({
  trigger,
  items,
  className,
  disabled,
  open: openProp,
  defaultOpen = false,
  onOpenChange,
  finalFocus,
  size = 'md',
}: MenuProps);

props.name: items
props.type:
Array<{
    label: string
    onClick?: () => void

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state, matching Popover and Modal. Omit it to let the menu manage itself.

notes: Menu accepts a ReactElement trigger and items with onClick. The export is Menu, not DropdownMenu.
Use a trigger that forwards its props/ref (Moru Button does). Preserve focus restoration and keyboard activation.
Menu manages its own open state by default. open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange are available when the application needs to control it, as with Popover and Modal.
